data.name: Ketti
data.gender_notes: Ketti is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'kettos', meaning 'two'. In early Christian tradition, the number two symbolizes perfection and unity in the divine. Ketti is a name for a child born into a loving and pure family. The name Ketti carries the meaning “Pure, Holy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ketti usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, holy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of spiritual purity and perfection.
data.etymology: Ketti belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Holy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ketti total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
